bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Lumentum is vertically integrated from chip design to module assembly, supplying the laser chips and photonic integrated circuits at the heart of co-packaged optics. The transition from pluggable to co-packaged roughly doubles Lumentum addressable market.
